metadata.description: Logii plugin for Claude, for real-estate agencies.

plugins.name: logii
plugins.description: Logii for Claude: read your agency's Logii data in plain words — people and buildings, lots, portfolios, management and syndic mandates, leases and vacancies, tenant and owner accounts, budgets, supplier contracts, work orders, condominium files and agency fees. Read-only; each person signs in with their own Logii access.
